about.kicker: Braskem · SAP Certified Fiori Application Developer · SAP Certified ABAP Cloud
about.headline: From GAP to go-live: Fiori, RAP and BTP on greenfield and brownfield ECC and S/4HANA projects.
about.body:
Senior SAP Fiori/BTP Developer, currently on Braskem's greenfield SAP ↔ Vendavo integration project. I run the delivery cycle (analysis, technical specification, sprint and functional delivery) with no modification to standard, following Clean Core guidelines.

On the front end, I build Fiori/SAPUI5 Freestyle and Fiori Elements experiences aligned with Design Guidelines, pixel perfect to Figma prototypes. On the back end, I model with RAP, ABAP Cloud and CDS Views, prioritizing solid OData contracts, performance and traceability.

On SAP BTP, I deliver solutions with BAS, CAP, Integration Suite, Destinations and HANA Cloud. I have hands-on experience with brownfield ECC → S/4HANA conversion (EWM, Event Management and maintenance), ICMS tax solutions for telecom and production support in high-volume retail.

braskem.role: Senior SAP Fiori / BTP Developer (SAPUI5 Freestyle, Integration Suite)
highlights: Working on the greenfield project integrating SAP with the Vendavo pricing platform, building SAPUI5 Freestyle applications on SAP BTP.
Implement screens pixel perfect to the business-approved Figma prototype, keeping adherence to Fiori Design Guidelines and reusable componentization.
Consume services exposed by SAP Integration Suite (iFlows) and SAP ECC through Destination Service and Cloud Connector, decoupling front end, middleware and back end.
Develop, build and deploy applications on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry) with SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), packaged as MTA with Approuter and XSUAA.
Keep every extension side-by-side on BTP, following Clean Core guidelines with no modifications to ECC standard.

vale.role: Senior SAP ABAP Fiori Developer (Brownfield S/4HANA Conversion)
highlights: Worked on the brownfield migration from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA, adapting custom developments to the new ecosystem and using the conversion to improve business flows.
Actively contributed to technical specification and development, proposing and implementing improvements that simplified processes and cut manual steps for users.
Adapted legacy code to S/4HANA (adaptability): remediated Z objects flagged by Custom Code Migration and ATC, adjusted to data model simplifications and replaced obsolete tables and transactions.
Handled modifications and enhancements during the upgrade (SPAU/SPDD), prioritizing return to standard and migration to BAdIs and Clean Core-aligned extensions.
Optimized critical transactions and reports with performance analysis via ST05 and SAT, rewriting data access with CDS Views and modern Open SQL.

subtopics.title: Logistics: SAP EWM and Event Management
items: Adapted and extended warehouse processes in SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) with BAdIs, enhancements and interface adjustments to the S/4HANA core.
Adjusted SAP Event Management for logistics event tracking, keeping integrations running after the conversion.

subtopics.title: Maintenance (MRO) and Fiori
items: Adapted maintenance developments (MRO, Maintenance, Repair and Operations) to S/4HANA, preserving ECC business rules.
Built and extended Fiori apps (Freestyle and Fiori Elements) and OData services (SEGW and RAP) to replace legacy transactions.

highlights: Development and support of custom and standard SAP solutions in ECC and S/4HANA landscapes, using SAP Fiori UI5 Freestyle, JavaScript, SAP BTP, Azure DevOps, Web IDE, SAP Business Application Studio and SAP Mobile Hybrid.
Development and maintenance of SAP Fiori UI5 Freestyle applications, ensuring adherence to SAP Fiori Design Guidelines (SAP BAS, VS Code and Web IDE).
Modeled CDS Views and RAP services consumed by Fiori Elements applications running in production at SIPAL, BRF and São Salvador Alimentos.
AMS support: diagnosed incidents across CDS Views, OData services and ABAP logic, delivering fixes through controlled transports to production.
Focal Freestyle front-end developer on the SAP implementation project under SAP Activate methodology.
Hybrid Fiori Elements + Freestyle applications: standard templates for list screens, custom code only on exception flows.
Managed the development lifecycle in Azure DevOps, from backlog to transport.

subtopics.title: Client/Allocation: SIPAL, Agricultural Optimization
items: SAPUI5/Fiori apps for agricultural management, exposing data through CDS Views, RAP and SAP Gateway (SEGW).
OData V2 and V4 services with standard service extensions, reducing coupling and rework across layers.
UX and performance tuning for fast execution by field and back-office teams.

subtopics.title: Client/Allocation: BRF, AppGrãos
items: Hybrid SAPUI5 (HAT) multichannel app, covering web, mobile, online and offline, for commodity purchasing, running in the field with no signal and syncing on reconnect.
OData integration over an SAP database holding millions of records, with validation and transactional traceability on every sync.
Delivery and evolution of critical flows (freight calculation, contract validations) executable by the buyer directly in the field.

subtopics.title: São Salvador Alimentos (SSA): SAP Technical Support (ABAP, Fiori and Asset Manager)
items: ECC and S/4HANA support in object-oriented and procedural ABAP: fixes in BAdIs, User Exits and Enhancement Points on standard modules, without breaking upgradeability.
SAP ↔ external system interfaces via BAPI, RFC, IDoc and Web Services, with error handling and traceable reprocessing.
ALV reports, Module Pool, SmartForms/Adobe Forms and BDC data loads, plus fixes in CDS Views, OData services and ABAP logic.
Development in Eclipse ADT with transports via TASK/TR and impact control across DEV, QAS and PRD.
SAP Asset Manager: configuration and technical extensions aligned to maintenance and asset management flows.

subtopics.title: Client/Allocation: LIGGA
items: Support and evolution of SAP solutions, focusing on technical fixes, stability, and continuous improvement in production.

thomson-reuters.role: SAP Full Stack JavaScript Developer (SAP Cloud Platform Neo, Tax/ICMS)

Implemented and tuned ICMS calculation and assessment rules, ensuring tax compliance across high volumes of fiscal documents.
Maintained integrations between the tax solution and the SAP back end, diagnosing and fixing critical production incidents.
Evolved HTML5/SAPUI5 applications on Neo with SAP Web IDE, owning deployment, stability and performance.
Developed and supported SAP ABAP and Fiori on the Americanas project, a very high-volume, business-critical retail landscape.
Delivered enhancements and fixes in ABAP OO programs, enhancements (BAdIs, User Exits) and interfaces via BAPI, RFC and IDoc.
Optimized high-volume reports and jobs with ST05 and SAT analysis, removing bottlenecks in critical processing.
Built and adjusted Fiori/SAPUI5 apps and OData services (SEGW) used by business teams.

SAP BTP (Neo) with SAP Web IDE and Business Application Studio (BAS), covering development, deployment and support.
Back-end integrations via SAP Gateway (SEGW) and OData V2, with clear contracts and decoupling across UI, services and data.
